name: Political Economy (BA)
intro: The Bachelor of Arts in Political Economy explores the intersection of economics with politics in domestic and international contexts. It prepares students for engagement with global and regional questions that require analysis of economic and political causes and consequences and provides a useful background for a wide variety of entry positions in the public and private sectors.

groups.sub: Complete two ECON and one MATH course (12 units):

notes: Economics Electives (12 units): Choose three Economics (ECON) courses numbered 300-499 (excludes ECON 351x and 352x)
International Relations Electives (8 units): Choose two International Relations (IR) courses numbered 300-499
Political Economy Electives (8 units): Choose two Political Economy in Political Science (POSC) courses numbered 300-499
